name: workshop-claude-code-amaleh-2026-boss-today
prompt:
Create a stunning HIGH-END workshop poster.

ALL TEXT IN HEBREW. 3:2 horizontal format.

Brand: Aviz - The Architect | Colors: #22C55E green, dark/black background

VISUAL HOOK - BOSS / KINGPIN ENERGY:
The Architect as a POWERFUL BOSS figure - sitting in a luxurious executive chair with arms crossed confidently. Money (bills, coins) floating/falling around him but he looks UNBOTHERED, like this is normal for him.

CRITICAL STYLE REQUIREMENTS:
- NOT smiling big - instead a CONFIDENT SMIRK or serious powerful expression
- Body language of a CEO/BOSS - commanding presence
- Expensive dark suit with green pocket square
- Dark, moody, CINEMATIC lighting
- Gold and green color accents
- AI robots/screens working in the background but SUBTLE
- Money floating but ELEGANTLY
- HIGH-END LUXURY aesthetic
- Sharp, clean composition
- Dramatic shadows and lighting

TEXT HIERARCHY (Hebrew):

LINE 1 (smaller, elegant): הסדנא שיכולה להיות שווה לך
LINE 2 (BIG, BOLD, GREEN, POWERFUL): המווווון כסף!
LINE 3 (medium): להיות 10x זה כבר לא קלישאה - זה פרקטיקה

BODY: אם העבודה שלך קשורה למחשב בצורה כלשהי, אתה חייב (!) ללמוד לעבוד עם הסוכן האוטונומי של קלוד. אבל בשביל זה אתה צריך לדעת את הסוד. לא כל עבודה עם סוכן מייצרת שיפור בביצועים. עקרון פשוט שתלמד בסדנה ותוכל ליישם מיד יעיף את כל העבודה שלך קדימה.

DETAILS SECTION - VERY IMPORTANT VISUAL EFFECT:
Show the date info: 50 ש״ח בביט | יום חמישי 1.1.26 | 21:00 | Zoom
BUT with a RED/ORANGE MARKER LINE crossed through the date "1.1.26"
AND above that crossed-out date, write "היום!" in BOLD HANDWRITTEN MARKER STYLE (like someone urgently wrote it by hand with a thick marker)
This should look like someone took a marker, crossed out the date, and wrote "TODAY!" above it

BRAND: Aviz - The Architect
